findings.title: fetch_error_details mismatches error IDs to nodestore data
findings.body: fetch_error_details builds node_ids from error_ids, calls nodestore get_multi, then does zip(error_ids, events.values()). get_multi returns a dict keyed by node_id and values() order is not guaranteed to match error_ids order, and missing keys shift alignment. The result pairs the wrong title/message/timestamp with the wrong id, corrupts chronological interleaving in gen_request_data, and sends wrong error context to Seer. It should look up each node_id individually instead of zipping values().

findings.title: TableWidgetVisualization rendered with empty data
findings.body: When the use-table-widget-visualization flag is on, tableResultComponent renders TableWidgetVisualization with hardcoded columns={[]} and tableData {data:[], meta:{fields:{},units:{}}}, discarding the actual result.data, result.meta, fields, and custom renderers computed just above. Every dashboard table under the flag will render empty instead of its query results.

findings.title: age/timestamp mutual-exclusion check uses truthiness
findings.body: validate_timestamp checks if self.initial_data.get("age") and validate_age checks if self.initial_data.get("timestamp"). Falsy-but-valid values like timestamp 0 or age 0 bypass the check, so a report containing both fields can pass validation. It also allows reports with neither field since both are required=False. The checks should test key presence, not truthiness, and require exactly one of the two.

findings.title: Analytics recorded before feature/auth check
findings.body: analytics.record for preprod_artifact.api.assemble runs before the organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble feature check. Disabled, unauthorized, or invalid requests are counted as assembles, inflating the metric and recording user/project IDs for requests that should be rejected with 404. The record call should happen after the feature gate passes.

findings.title: Unmemoized projectIds churns query key every render
findings.body: projectIds is derived inline via projects.map(...) or selection.projects, creating a new array identity on every render, but it is a dependency of the useMemo that builds queryOptions and the queryKey. The queryKey therefore changes every render, causing useQuery to refetch trace-item attribute keys continuously. projectIds should be memoized.
